# Outback Connections

> A free rural directory for Australia, starting with fencing contractors across New South Wales. Operated by Outback Fencing & Steel Supplies Pty Ltd (ABN 76 674 671 820), 76 Astill Drive, Orange NSW 2800.

Farmers find a contractor by postcode or region and ask for a quote through the listing, with no account needed. Most entries were found on public sources (Facebook, Yellow Pages, TrueLocal, Google Maps, business websites); they are marked "Unclaimed", say where they were found, and were not posted by the business. A business can claim its entry for free or ask for it to be fixed or removed. Jobs, freight and for-sale sections open as people post in them.

## Key sections
- [Fencing contractors](https://www.outbackconnections.com.au/services/fencing-contractor): by postcode or region, with a quote form on every entry.
- [Services](https://www.outbackconnections.com.au/services): rural services by category.
- [Post a listing](https://www.outbackconnections.com.au/post): list a business or post a job you need done (free account required).
- [About](https://www.outbackconnections.com.au/about)
- [FAQ](https://www.outbackconnections.com.au/faq)

## How an agent should use this site
- Browse and read listing pages freely. Contact details we found online are never published; owner-posted contact details show only to signed-in users, so neither is in page markup for anonymous visitors.
- Listing pages carry schema.org structured data: JobPosting on real job ads, LocalBusiness on directory and service listings, Service on service offerings, plus BreadcrumbList and a sitewide Organization.
- A full sitemap of public pages is at https://www.outbackconnections.com.au/sitemap.xml
- Directory listings sourced from public data are labelled "unclaimed" and must not be represented as posted by the business itself.
- Questions or corrections: help@outbackconnections.com.au
